policy.native_library_loading: explicit trusted path, ABI/version validation and caller-owned buffers
policy.desktop_wire_transport: DABI64 Desktop Host v1 defines frames; DuckOS kernel IPC and caller authentication remain pending
policy.unavailable_peer_behavior: typed unavailable state; no partial privileged action

peers.role: primary language, compiler/toolchain and deterministic policy layer
peers.workbench_maturity: host-native-toolchain; native DuckOS kernel integration pending

contracts.purpose: Pointer-free fixed-width desktop request/response frames with bounded payloads and opaque host-issued handles.
consumer_rules: The kernel derives sender identity and capabilities; client frames cannot provide either.
The receiver validates ownership, sequence freshness, quotas, session and operation payloads.
No kernel IPC, desktop service dispatch or privilege is implied by frame validation.

contracts.purpose: Defines Reaper's additive federation role and the existing peer contract ownership.
consumer_rules: Reaper remains a user-space language and toolchain, not the DuckOS kernel.
Peer absence or malformed data produces a typed error and no partial privileged action.
Do not introduce a second message bus or mandatory central runtime.

prohibited_effects: implicit shell, filesystem, process or network effects
treating policy models as kernel enforcement

peers.role: read-only processor, memory and diagnostics evidence provider
peers.workbench_maturity: native C11 host workbench; DuckOS service integration pending

contracts.purpose: Reuses the existing C11 ABI for bounded processor and metric functions.
consumer_rules: Load only from an explicit trusted local path and validate ABI compatibility.
Use caller-owned buffers and preserve units, workload, duration and provenance.
Do not create a second ABI solely for NEXUS integration.

contracts.purpose: Defines CPU topology, ISA, bounded measurement and profile evidence.
consumer_rules: Keep hardware discovery and measurement read-only.
Unavailable counters remain unavailable; do not invent estimates.
A benchmark does not authorize scheduler, affinity, clock or voltage changes.

contracts.purpose: Defines allowed evidence use by future DuckOS service and application consumers.
consumer_rules: Reports are advisory evidence, not a page allocator or kernel memory manager.
Validate provider, timestamp, workload, units, bounds and freshness.
The Reaper policy example remains optional CI validation, not a runtime dependency.

peers.role: read-only device, driver-package, signature and GPU evidence provider
peers.workbench_maturity: read-only user-space workbench; DuckOS device service integration pending

contracts.purpose: Publishes device inventory and pseudonymous fingerprints with source mode, bounds and digest.
consumer_rules: Validate schema, source mode, bounds and digest.
Keep unsupported or missing fields explicit; preserve provider and capture time.
Do not interpret device matching as driver installation permission.

contracts.purpose: Exports read-only GPU telemetry with provider and validity metadata.
consumer_rules: Unsupported readings remain null or unavailable.
Do not infer direct VRAM mapping, GPU bypass or device-control permission.
Do not turn hashes or signatures alone into a trust verdict.

contracts.purpose: Defines NEXUS device-evidence ownership and allowed consumers.
consumer_rules: Inspect package data only; never extract or execute untrusted payloads.
Driver installation, firmware flashing and device mutation remain out of scope.
Compatibility candidates are evidence, not certification.

prohibited_effects: automatic driver install, enable, unload or replacement

peers.role: procedural audio, asset metadata and offline DSP provider
peers.workbench_maturity: native C++20 host workbench; DuckOS audio service integration pending

contracts.purpose: Exchanges generated audio assets and pack metadata without treating them as executable plugins.
consumer_rules: Preserve seed, variation, render settings, sample rate, channel layout and provenance.
Treat imported packs and plugins as data until a separate trust model exists.
Reaper may validate supported metadata but must not rewrite audio payloads.

contracts.purpose: Carries deterministic preset and render configuration metadata.
consumer_rules: Validate the preset schema and enforce file/size bounds.
A fixed configuration and seed must retain the project's declared deterministic behavior.
Offline render metadata does not grant audio-device or microphone access.

contracts.purpose: Defines offline audio provider boundaries and the separate future AudioSubsys relationship.
consumer_rules: Keep processing offline by default.
Do not route offline DSP into a real-time callback by implication.
Real-time audio requires a separate DuckOS-owned device, scheduling and recovery contract.

prohibited_effects: kernel audio driver or device ownership
background recording or hidden microphone access
